## Personality

Emmeline Drew is characterized by a notable lack of initiative. By the fifth volume, she is recognized as having no gumption.

## History

Emmeline Drew once snubbed a certain old bachelor of [Lowbridge](../codex/places.md#lowbridge) during a prior meeting. Following that encounter, she resolved that she would not snub him the next time she saw him.
